text:
Mia R.: Heads up — ran into a weird one during EOD invoice generation. Several invoices show a negative credit line and one customer got two PDFs with the same invoice number.
Conor: Ugh. Which customer / invoice numbers?
Mia R.: ACME Corp. invoices 2026-03-22-AC-1123 (negative line -$12.50) and duplicate PDF for 2026-03-22-AC-1124 — both generated at 20:07 UTC.
Billing Bot: invoice-generator ERROR: reconciliation mismatch for customer_id=acme-001, invoice_id=2026-03-22-AC-1124, reason=duplicate_pdf_write (s3 key conflict)
Jess L.: Thanks. Any idea whether the negative credit line is a true credit or a mistaken zeroing of a usage line?
Mia R.: Looks like the "reserved_capacity_credit" got applied twice in the final join. In the CSV from usage-rollup I see two rows for that SKU for the same commit id: 
```
acme-001,2026-03-22,reserved_capacity,qty=1,amount=-12.50,commit=cb7a1f
acme-001,2026-03-22,reserved_capacity,qty=1,amount=-12.50,commit=cb7a1f
```
Conor: That smells like a duplicate partition processed by the aggregator. Oliver, any recent deploys to usage-rollup?
Oliver K.: rolled usage-rollup v2.9.4 at 19:58 UTC — I saw a retry loop for one SQS batch right after deploy. Investigating whether the retry created a duplicate output file.
Jess L.: Short term: can we cancel the duplicate invoice send and push corrected invoices? We should also stop auto-finalize until we confirm fix.
Mia R.: Agree. Billing Bot — please disable auto-finalize for invoices > $0 for the next hour.
Billing Bot: command accepted: auto_finalize set to false (expires in 60m) :white_check_mark:
Conor: For the duplicate PDF, we should remove the duplicate S3 key and re-run pdf-generation for the correct invoice_id. Does the PDF include the mistaken negative line or do both PDFs differ?
Mia R.: Both PDFs are identical except the invoice numbers are the same; one references generated_at 20:07:12 and the other 20:07:45. Contents show the duplicated credit line, so root cause is upstream duplicate row.
Oliver K.: Found the retry evidence: usage-rollup enqueued the same partition job twice due to a visibility timeout bug. PR incoming to patch handler; will revert v2.9.4 rollback if needed.
Jess L.: Action items: 
- Oliver: hotfix queue visibility handler and redeploy (ETA 30m)
- Mia: prepare corrected invoices for ACME (generate corrected PDFs and issue credit memo for duplicate) (ETA 45m)
- Conor: coordinate with support to notify ACME about a corrected invoice and expected credit
- Billing Bot: keep auto_finalize off until we confirm no other duplicates
Mia R.: I'll draft the email to ACME and attach the corrected invoice + credit memo. Tagging @Conor for approval once draft is ready.
Conor: Approve for send once you include the explanation + apology and note the credit memo amount.
Billing Bot: alert: audit-log entry created for invoice_id=2026-03-22-AC-1124 duplication, ticket=#INV-4392
Oliver K.: Deploying hotfix now to staging, will push to prod after 10m smoke tests.
Mia R.: If anyone sees other customers with negative reserved_capacity credits, please drop invoice ids here. I'll run a query: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoices WHERE line_description LIKE '%reserved_capacity%' AND amount < 0 AND generated_at >= '2026-03-22T00:00:00Z'
Jess L.: Also let's add an alert in PagerDuty if more than 3 such negative-credit invoices are generated in an hour.
Conor: Good call. Keep me posted. Thanks team :thumbsup:
